clues.text: In Jerusalem, Jesus drove out the buyers and sellers here and overturned the tables of the money changers.
King Solomon built it in seven years, finishing every detail in the month of Bul.
Solomon's builders cut its stones at the quarry, so no hammer or chisel was heard during construction.
While tempting Jesus, the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on its pinnacle.
Jesus said to destroy this and He would raise it in three days, and He was speaking of His body.
After searching three days, Mary and Joseph found the boy Jesus here, sitting among the teachers.
In a parable of Jesus, a Pharisee and a tax collector went up here to pray.
